segments.tha-ap485:1.3: Uddharāmi bhisaṃ tattha, ghāsahetu [asanahetu (syā.)] ahaṃ tadā.
segments.tha-ap485:4.3: Madhuṃ bhisehi savati, khīraṃ sappiṃ muḷālibhi.
segments.tha-ap485:7.1: “‘Sukhī hotu [hohi (sī. syā. pī. ka.)] mahāpuñña, gati tuyhaṃ samijjhatu;
segments.tha-ap485:9.3: Bhisaṃ rukkhe lagetvāna [laggitvāna (syā. ka.)], mama dānamanussariṃ.
segments.tha-ap485:11.3: Sohaṃ nisinnako santo, tattha kālaṅkato ahuṃ.
segments.tha-ap485:12.3: Kaḷevaraṃ me patitaṃ, devaloke ramiṃ ahaṃ.
segments.tha-ap485:13.3: Sāyapātaṃ [sāyaṃ pātaṃ (syā. ka.)] upaṭṭhanti, bhisadānassidaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.tha-ap485:14.3: Bhoge me ūnatā natthi, bhisadānassidaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.tha-ap485:18.1: “Svāgataṃ vata me āsi … pe … kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.tha-ap485:20.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā bhisadāyako thero imā gāthāyo Abhāsitthāti.

lines: Tatiyāpadāne madhuṃ bhisehi savatīti pokkharamadhupadumakesarehi savati paggharati.
Khīraṃ sappiṃ muḷālibhīti khīrañca sappirasañca padumamuḷālehi savati paggharati.
Tasmā tadubhayaṃ mama santakaṃ buddho paṭiggaṇhatūti attho.
